title: Iteration of the trial-testing step
statement: For bit strings $Q,s$, a bit $b$, and an iteration count $i\in\mathbb{N}$, iterating the trial-testing step $i$ times from the encoded state with query $Q$, remaining string $s$, and flag $b$ yields the state with query $Q$, remaining string obtained by deleting the first $i|q|$ bits of $s$, and flag equal to $b$ conjoined with the outcomes of the trial test on each of the first $i$ consecutive blocks of $s$ of length $|q|$, where $q$ is the query's length component.
